response.sql: WITH filtered_budget AS (SELECT category, amount, spent, remaining FROM budget WHERE amount >= 75), category_stats AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) as avg_remaining, SUM(amount - spent) as total_diff FROM filtered_budget GROUP BY category), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(total_diff) as overall_average FROM category_stats) SELECT cs.category, cs.avg_remaining, cs.total_diff, (cs.total_diff - oa.overall_average) as above_average FROM category_stats cs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE cs.total_diff > oa.overall_average
